title: Restore the bamboo grove
description: The grove has run wild. Choose where to begin; every approach can be finished in time.

approaches.title: A shaded planting corner
approaches.description: Clear the tangled understory and fill the deep shade with forest grass and hostas.

stages.title: Clear the understory
stages.description: Clear four overgrown patches in the grove.

stages.title: Plant the shade
stages.description: Grow three forest grasses or hostas in the grove to their full size.

approaches.title: A sheltered wildlife refuge
approaches.description: Build a refuge among the bamboo, and let wildlife find it.

stages.title: Build a refuge
stages.description: Build a natural shelter in the grove.

stages.title: Residents settle
stages.description: Wait for wildlife to move into a shelter in the grove.

approaches.title: A path and stone feature
approaches.description: Lay stepping stones deeper into the grove, and set a bamboo water spout beside the old basin.

stages.title: Open the way
stages.description: Place three stepping stones or stone paths in the grove.

stages.title: Water and stone
stages.description: Build a bamboo water spout in the grove.
